title: TypeSafe judges are direct typesafe:/ models, not gateway endpoints
answers: can I use a TypeSafe gateway endpoint as a judge model
make_judge gateway TypeSafe model not working
which feedback types does TypeSafe support for judges
TypeSafe judge bool or Literal only
body:
Invariant: make_judge() treats TypeSafe models only as direct `typesafe:/<model>` URIs; `gateway:/...` must not be used for TypeSafe judges, and TypeSafe gateway passthrough endpoints are not judge models or judge-selector options.
Invariant: feedback_value_type must be `bool` or a finite `Literal[...]`. Literal values must be JSON string/number/boolean scalars with distinct string forms, 1 to 255 values.
Constraints: TypeSafe Noul/Choice questions have no abstention, so a bool judge cannot separate 'unknown' from False; add an explicit value such as "unknown" to a Literal. Score outputs, {{ trace }}, inference_params, base_url, extra_headers, and multi-question judges are unsupported. Gateway-backed TypeSafe judge execution is deferred to a follow-up.
applies: Changes to make_judge TypeSafe support or to TypeSafe documentation and gateway docs.
says: Selecting an AI gateway endpoint when creating an evaluation judge fails for TypeSafe models.
Support routing custom judge evaluations through the centralized model gateway endpoints.
Boolean evaluation judges cannot distinguish between a false result and an uncertain answer.
Numeric score outputs are rejected when configuring custom automated evaluation judges.
search: make_judge() requires TypeSafe models to be configured exclusively via direct typesafe:/<model> URIs rather than gateway:/ endpoints or gateway passthrough options. Supported feedback_value_type options are strictly limited to bool or a finite Literal of 1 to 255 distinct scalar values. Because TypeSafe questions provide no abstention mechanism, boolean judges cannot separate false from unknown, requiring an explicit choice value instead. Unsupported features include gateway-backed execution, numeric score outputs, multi-question judges, inference_params, base_url, extra_headers, and trace variable substitutions.
